description: This file defines the GpuDelegateFactory class in Java, responsible for creating GPU delegate instances for TensorFlow Lite. It includes an inner Options class for configuring delegate options and supports runtime flavor-based delegate creation with reflection.

classes.name: GpuDelegateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating GPU delegates based on runtime flavor and options.

classes.description: Configuration options for GPU delegate instances, including backend type, inference preferences, and serialization settings.

methods.description: Constructor initializing with specified delegate options.
